thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up — we have a vendor invoice lag plus a pricing experiment that materially bumped hosted API usage in July. Need guidance for month‑end: should we accrue for unbilled usage and how to treat experiment credits? attaching quick calc: https://tiny.redwood/close/2145
Tom Patel: Is this vendor invoice or customer billings that are unbilled? need to know where to book.
Maria Chen: It's customer usage that hasn't invoiced yet (2 large trial customers) + one pass-through vendor line. Spreadsheet with raw numbers: https://tiny.redwood/close/2145 (per-customer tab included).
Alex Rivera: Pulled raw usage. Estimated unbilled = $72,400 as of 7/31 using avg price from July invoices. Quick JE template i put together:
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 72,400
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 72,400
Memo: Accrual for unbilled July usage (pricing experiment impact)
```
Emma Stone: Need GL confirmation — 1300 for Unbilled AR and 4000 for Usage revenue ok. Also question: experiment issued $15k in promo credits. Do we net credits against the accrual or book separately as contra-revenue?
Maria Chen: Product confirms credits show as invoice line-item adjustments (reduces billed revenue). For the accrual we should net them. Net accrual = 72,400 - 15,000 = 57,400. I'll flag the experiment tag in the backup.
Tom Patel: If net > $50k then CFO approval required, right? @CFO_Jess :thinking_face:
CFO_Jess: I saw the initial summary. Approve the accrual methodology but I need backup: per-customer breakout, the experiment flag export, and the math in one place. Please route to me by EOD for sign-off.
Alex Rivera: Added per-customer breakout and the experiment export to the same spreadsheet (tab: CFO_backup). Link: https://tiny.redwood/close/2145#gid=2
finance-bot: Invoice upload detected: vendor-invoice-9987.pdf (received 2145680000).
Emma Stone: From a revrec perspective, services were delivered in July, so accrual (accrued revenue) is correct rather than deferral. I'll add an explanation paragraph to the close pack for auditors.
Maria Chen: Plan: Alex to post the journal in NetSuite tomorrow AM for the net amount $57,400, Tom to route the CFO backup, Emma to add the footnote to the close pack. Any objections?
Tom Patel: :thumbsup: no objections, will route to Jess.
CFO_Jess: Approved. Once journal is posted, tag close-pack PR #312 and I'll sign off.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll update the posting checklist and mark this task as done in the close board.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export for month-end accrual discussion. Short, informal messages, links, code block for journal entry, approvals requested and granted.
